resources.string: Long car routes can be calculated much faster with your own routing server (services/route-server): the server suggests the way, the app builds the route from your maps as usual. Start, destination and intermediate points are sent to the server. Without a server or if it fails, the app calculates on its own.
The token of this device from scripts/new-token.sh. Leave empty to keep the stored token.
Use https:// (http:// only in the local network)
Enter the server address and the access token as well
